component.name: Ludodex
component.summary: Import your games, pick one at random and track your play sessions

description.p: A GTK4/libadwaita game library manager: imports your games (Steam, itch.io, Flatpak, Lutris, RetroArch), picks a random game to play based on your mood and the time available, and keeps a retrospective of your play sessions with Markdown notes and your own achievements.
Ludodex works entirely locally: a SQLite database, a Markdown note per game, and no account required.
